prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Empire C02 science-fiction skill action icon, one genuine transparent RGBA cutout, square 1254×1254, designed for an actual 48×48 runtime icon with center anchor [24,24].
Reference roles: Image 1 is the exact original higher-resolution skill-board slot and fixes subject, function, view and arrangement. Its magenta background is NOT part of the subject. Image 2 is approved chunky sci-fi cargo-crate STYLE ONLY: use its confident thick contour, simplified large forms, broad matte planes and restrained value steps; do not copy crates, cargo parts, colors that contradict the icon, or extra equipment.
Style/medium: Exaggerated chunky hand-drawn cartoon icon, bold dark contour, broad opaque cel-shaded planes, two-to-three material values, generous clean separations and tiny hard-edged highlights. No realistic rendering, oil, gloss, gradients, microtexture, tiny scratches, rivet clutter, filigree, embossed ornament or wallpaper detail. Functional science-fiction materials, never medieval gear with glow stripes.
Composition: Preserve the original subject's orientation and functional visual motif but simplify to the few main masses that remain legible at 48 pixels. One tightly grouped centered icon, comfortably inside the canvas with 6–8% transparent margin on every side. All parts intact, no clipped tips or detached flecks near the canvas edge. No text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, badge frame, UI panel, floor, platform added for decoration or ground shadow.
Transparency: Truly transparent background and open gaps. The object and action glyphs are opaque painted shapes. No fake checkerboard, no colored background, no magenta, no soft outer glow, aura, halo, bloom, haze, particle mist, cast shadow or semi-transparent glass. Keep any functional energy confined to explicit bounded shapes from the original motif; use clean edges rather than luminous bleed. No programmatic cleanup is intended.
Primary request: Rebuild C02 动力突击 / power assault. Preserve the original diagonal short cylindrical power-weapon assembly entering from lower-left toward upper-right: a blue-gray metal core with two broad ivory/steel retaining rings and dark recesses, and a short dark metallic forward blade/strike form projecting toward lower-left. The dominant action cue is ONE thick sweeping crescent of cool blue/cyan stroke curving from lower-left around the right side and curling toward upper-center, matching the original crescent composition. Treat the crescent as a crisp, bounded, opaque blue action ribbon with a pale inner plane and dark teal outer contour, not a large glow cloud or transparent energy field. Reduce its many tiny spikes to two or three bold tapered lobes. Omit tiny floating stone chips; they are expendable detail, not the identity. Keep power-weapon rings and crescent distinct at 48px. No sword hilt, soldier, fist, firearm muzzle-flash, religious star, shield or radial aura. The source meaning is a powered melee assault, not a scan or defense icon.
